# Dead-port and stylesheet rejections carry no reason

## Context

A SharedWorkers client workspace (embedded-editor app, private repo) runs an app-worker `unhandledrejection` logger. Its field log shows `unhandled rejection: undefined` — a rejection carrying literally zero information. A CDP attach to the app SharedWorker (Playwright page consoles cannot see shared workers) reproduced the signature on demand and pinned the origin: `Runtime.exceptionThrown`, text `Uncaught (in promise)`, reason `undefined`, at `src/worker/Base.mjs:411`.

Live latest-open sweep: checked latest 20 open issues at 2026-08-30T22:15Z; no equivalent found. Closest neighbors: #17888 AC-4 (Manager forwarded-rejection envelope — different surface, see Out of Scope), #16623 (introduced the DragZone sentinel consumption this ticket must preserve), #8896 (node-side rejection handling, unrelated realm).

## The Problem

Two engine seams reject bare:

1. `src/worker/Base.mjs:411` — `promiseMessage`'s dead-port branch: when `sendMessage` resolves no live port (a window closed; SharedWorkers), it calls `reject()` with no reason.
2. `src/main/addon/Stylesheet.mjs:153` — a stylesheet `link` error handler calls `reject()` with no reason, so a 404'd theme file surfaces as reasonless.

A bare rejection is undiagnosable at every consumer: uncaught, it prints `undefined` (the field sighting); caught, it cannot be told apart from any other bare rejection. In the field case the caller was identifiable only by CDP-attaching to the worker — the log line itself said nothing.

**The constraint that shapes the fix:** the dead-port `undefined` is currently a LOAD-BEARING sentinel. `src/draggable/DragZone.mjs:445` (from #16623) discriminates `reason !== undefined` to settle closed-window proxy-cleanup silently — the node died with its window, cleanup is moot — while logging reasoned rejections as real delta failures. A naive `reject(new Error(...))` would turn every cross-window drag teardown into console noise. Sweep receipt: DragZone:445 is the only `reason/err === undefined` discriminator in `src/`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `promiseMessage` (`src/worker/Base.mjs:402`) is the promise seam over `sendMessage`, whose JSDoc already documents the undefined-return no-port contract ("callers which require delivery must check it"). The reject happens locally in the calling worker — no serialization boundary for the reason object itself.
- When the call is a remote-method proxy, `opts` carries `remoteClassName` + `remoteMethod` (`src/worker/mixin/RemoteMethodAccess.mjs` `generateRemote`) — the exact context a diagnosable message needs (the field case would have read `Neo.main.addon.DockFlip.captureFirst` instead of `undefined`).
- #17888 AC-4 (in flight, @neo-gpt) normalizes the **Manager envelope** for forwarded rejections, where only `err.message`-shaped data may survive. The discriminator must therefore live in BOTH a structured field (`code`) and the message string, so a forwarded dead-port rejection stays recognizable where only the message survives.

## The Fix

1. `src/worker/Base.mjs` `promiseMessage`: reject with a typed error —
   `Object.assign(new Error('worker.Base#promiseMessage: no live port for destination "<dest>" (<action>[ <remoteClassName>.<remoteMethod>]) — a window closed?'), {code: 'NEO_DEAD_PORT'})`.
2. `src/draggable/DragZone.mjs:445`: migrate the discriminator from `reason !== undefined` to `reason?.code !== 'NEO_DEAD_PORT'`; update the in-place comment to name the typed sentinel.
3. `src/main/addon/Stylesheet.mjs:153`: reject with an Error naming the failed href.
4. Specs: new `test/playwright/unit/worker/Base.spec.mjs` (deliberately NOT `ReplyLoss.spec.mjs`, which #17888 is editing) proving the dead-port rejection carries `code: 'NEO_DEAD_PORT'` + destination + remote context in the message; a DragZone discriminator pair proving silent-settle on `NEO_DEAD_PORT` and a logged failure on any other reason.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `promiseMessage`'s dead-port branch rejects with an `Error` whose `code === 'NEO_DEAD_PORT'` and whose message names the destination and, for remote-method calls, `remoteClassName.remoteMethod`.
- [ ] AC-2: `DragZone#destroyDragProxy` settles silently exactly for `NEO_DEAD_PORT` reasons and logs every other rejection — a spec pair proves both arms.
- [ ] AC-3: the Stylesheet link-error path rejects with an `Error` naming the failed href.
- [ ] AC-4: grep receipt in the PR: zero bare `reject()` calls remain in `src/`.
- [ ] AC-5: full unit suite green in fully-parallel mode.

## Out of Scope

- The Manager forwarded-rejection envelope (`src/worker/Manager.mjs`) — owned by #17888 AC-4 (@neo-gpt); this ticket touches neither `Manager.mjs` nor `ReplyLoss.spec.mjs`.
- Any change to WHEN the dead-port branch fires — the port-resolution cascade is untouched; only the rejection's payload changes.
